# The Green Radius Game

> A self-ranking sustainability game for Burning Man theme camps, made by the Green
> Theme Camp Community. A camp answers up to 60 Yes/No questions across six sectors
> (food, water, waste, transport, shelter, power), gets a radial badge showing how far
> its "green radius" reaches, and receives a Green-Up Plan built from every No answer.

Playing is free, takes about 10 to 20 minutes, and needs no account. A camp enters its
name, sustainability lead, email, playa address, and camp size, then answers questions in
one of two modes: a spinning wheel (pick a sector at a time) or a single linear form.
Results are emailed as a permanent share link and are also tallied into an anonymous
city-wide view.

Scoring is self-reported and deliberately non-competitive. There are no ranks, titles, or
leaderboards, and camps are never compared to each other by name. The public city page
shows aggregate numbers only.

## Pages

- [Play the game](https://greenradi.us/): the game itself, and an FAQ covering scoring, privacy, and the two play modes.
- [The City's Green Radius](https://greenradi.us/city/): anonymous city-wide tally. Aggregate counts, sector spread, momentum, and the biggest shared opportunities. No camp is identifiable here.
- [Your result](https://greenradi.us/result/): renders one camp's badge and Green-Up Plan from the payload in the link. Needs the `?r=` parameter from that camp's own result link, so there is nothing to read at the bare path.

## Downloads

- [Board game, coloring wheel, and matrix (PDF)](https://greenradi.us/downloads/2026.05.19%20Green%20Radius%20Game%20--%20Download%20for%20Players%20--%20Board%20Game%20-%20Coloring%20Wheel%20-%20Matrix%20--%20v%2026%20FINAL%20.pdf): print-and-play version for camps without connectivity on playa.
- [How to play, with matrix detail (PDF)](https://greenradi.us/downloads/2026.05.19%20Green%20Radius%20Game%20--%20Download%20for%20Players%20--%20How-to-Play%20-%20Board%20Game%20-%20Matrix%20-%20Detail%20--%20v%2026%20FINAL%20.pdf): full rules and the question matrix.

## Notes for agents

- Camp submissions are private. Camp names, emails, and answers are never exposed by any public endpoint. `GET /api/city` returns an allowlisted set of aggregate fields only.
- `/admin/` is gated behind Cloudflare Access and is not public.
- The site is a static app fronted by one Cloudflare Worker. Result links are self-contained: `/result/?r=...` decodes entirely in the browser and keeps working if the backend is down.
